status: Exploratory protocol written before new numerical results

history.target: mean over current fixed neighbors of log(future distance/current distance), divided by horizon 0.6; also disturbed-minus-baseline response
history.primary_model: train-standardized quadratic ridge, regularization selected on validation only
controls: reversed lag order with matched refit

scope: 3D incompressible periodic cube side 6, constant density/viscosity, no walls or thermal phase change. A localized band-limited curl impulse disturbs only one cloned state. No feedback from markers. Fog/smoke use separate dilute heavy-sphere Stokes-drag observations of air. Ice, compressible gas, phase change, wall boundary variation and fully developed turbulence are separate proposed extensions.
